newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy transport committee votes against DPEF.
newsitem.headline: Italy transport committee votes against DPEF.

text.p: The transport committee of the lower house of parliament on Wednesday rejected the Italian government's three-year economic plan (DPEF) in a vote without repercussions for the package as a whole.
The DPEF, which is being examined by the relevant lower house committees before going to a parliamentary vote in the full chambers, has already been approved by the house's finance committee.
It is due to be voted by the budget committee on June 18.

The transport committee voted 25 against to 21 for, with hard-left Communist Refoundation -- the centre-left government's uneasy allies in the lower house where they hold the balance of power -- voting against.
